---
title: "Persistence & Transfer (Day 3)"
subtitle: "Three-day follow-up of social norm conformity across moral and monetary domains"
author: "Przemek Marcowski"
---

This notebook analyzes the three-day follow-up assessment against Day 0 across Experiment 1 (moral domain: animal lives) and Experiment 2 (monetary domain: dollars). The primary test is whether conformity shifts induced on Day 0 persist three days later and whether asymmetries between risk-averse and risk-seeking norms endure over the delay.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsignif)
library(here)

here::i_am("analysis/day3.qmd")
set.seed(42)
dir.create(here("output"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Define factor levels for consistent ordering
TIME_LEVELS <- c("Dayone", "Followup")
PHASE_LEVELS <- c("Baseline", "OwnD0", "OwnD3", "Others")
CONDITION_LEVELS <- c("Risk Averse", "Risk Seeking")
DOMAIN_LEVELS <- c("Gains", "Losses")
FRAME_LEVELS <- c("Lives", "Money")

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- ifelse(abs(x) < 0.5 * 10^(-digits), 0, x)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

fmt_conformity_table <- function(phase_df, pair_df, phase_label = "OwnD3") {
  bind_rows(
    phase_df %>%
      transmute(
        domain = factor(domain, levels = DOMAIN_LEVELS),
        ord = if_else(condition == "Risk Averse", 1L, 2L),
        Contrast = paste0(condition, " (", phase_label, " \u2212 Baseline)"),
        estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, z.ratio, p.value
      ),
    pair_df %>%
      transmute(
        domain = factor(domain, levels = DOMAIN_LEVELS),
        ord = 3L,
        Contrast = "Norm asymmetry (Risk Averse \u2212 Risk Seeking)",
        estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, z.ratio, p.value
      )
  ) %>%
    arrange(domain, ord) %>%
    transmute(
      Domain = as.character(domain),
      Contrast = Contrast,
      `ΔP [95% CI]` = sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", fmt_num(estimate), fmt_num(asymp.LCL), fmt_num(asymp.UCL)),
      z = fmt_num(z.ratio),
      p = fmt_p(p.value)
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable(align = "llrrr")
}
```

# Sample & Model Fitting

Each experiment is analyzed across all four assessment phases: baseline and immediate post-exposure on Day 0, followed by personal choices and predictions of another group's choices on Day 3.

```{r load-data}
# Load Experiment 1 data (Lives frame)
e1_data_full <- readRDS(here("data/experiment1.Rds"))
e1_data <- e1_data_full %>%
  filter(phase %in% PHASE_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = TIME_LEVELS),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = PHASE_LEVELS),
    domain = factor(domain, levels = DOMAIN_LEVELS)
  ) %>%
  select(-age, -influence_score, -comprehensionCorrectPercentage, -gamble_value_base)

# Load Experiment 2 data (Money frame)
e2_data_full <- readRDS(here("data/experiment2.Rds"))
e2_data <- e2_data_full %>%
  filter(phase %in% PHASE_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = TIME_LEVELS),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = PHASE_LEVELS),
    domain = factor(domain, levels = DOMAIN_LEVELS)
  ) %>%
  select(-age, -influence_score, -comprehensionCorrectPercentage, -gamble_value_base)

# Combine both experiments for joint analysis
combined_data <- bind_rows(e1_data, e2_data) %>%
  mutate(frame = factor(frame, levels = FRAME_LEVELS))
```

We fit mixed-effects logistic regression models across all four phases for Experiment 1, Experiment 2, and the pooled dataset, with random intercepts for participants.

```{r model-fitting}
# Model formulas across Baseline, OwnD0, OwnD3, Others
e1_formula_d3 <- formula(choice ~ ev * phase * condition * domain + (1 | id))
e2_formula_d3 <- formula(choice ~ ev * phase * condition * domain + (1 | id))
combined_formula_d3 <- formula(choice ~ ev * phase * condition * domain * frame + (1 | id))

# Model control parameters
model_control <- glmmTMBControl(
  optCtrl = list(iter.max = 1e+3, eval.max = 1e+3),
  parallel = min(4L, max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L))
)

model_file_path <- here("output/models_day3.Rds")

if (!file.exists(model_file_path)) {
  e1_model_d3 <- glmmTMB(
    e1_formula_d3, data = e1_data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    control = model_control
  )

  e2_model_d3 <- glmmTMB(
    e2_formula_d3, data = e2_data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    control = model_control
  )

  combined_model_d3 <- glmmTMB(
    combined_formula_d3, data = combined_data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    control = model_control
  )

  models_d3 <- list(e1_model_d3, e2_model_d3, combined_model_d3)
  saveRDS(models_d3, file = model_file_path)
} else {
  models_d3 <- readRDS(file = model_file_path)
  e1_model_d3 <- models_d3[[1]]
  e2_model_d3 <- models_d3[[2]]
  combined_model_d3 <- models_d3[[3]]
}
```

# Experiment 1: Moral Domain (Lives)

In Experiment 1, we estimate predicted choice probabilities across expected value at baseline and the three-day follow-up, marginal gamble acceptance across all four phases, within-condition persistence contrasts from baseline to Day 3, and the interaction contrast comparing risk-averse and risk-seeking norm persistence.

```{r e1-d3-contrasts}
# Predicted probabilities for plotting (Baseline vs. OwnD3)
e1_predicted_probs_d3 <- estimate_means(
  e1_model_d3,
  by = c("phase = c('Baseline', 'OwnD3')", "condition", "domain", "ev"),
  length = 100
)

# Marginal means and contrasts across all four phases
e1_emmeans_d3 <- withr::with_seed(42, emmeans(
  e1_model_d3, revpairwise ~ phase | condition | domain,
  regrid = "response", infer = TRUE, adjust = "mvt",
  at = list(phase = c("Baseline", "OwnD0", "OwnD3", "Others"))
))
e1_emmeans_df_d3 <- as.data.frame(e1_emmeans_d3$emmeans)
e1_contrasts_df_d3 <- as.data.frame(e1_emmeans_d3$contrasts) %>%
  mutate(p_lab = cut(p.value, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
e1_contrasts_subset_d3 <- e1_contrasts_df_d3[grepl("OwnD3 - Baseline", e1_contrasts_df_d3$contrast), ]

# Contrasts of contrasts: (Baseline - OwnD3)[Risk Averse] vs. (OwnD3 - Baseline)[Risk Seeking]
e1_conds_emmeans_d3 <- emmeans(
  e1_model_d3, ~ condition * phase | domain,
  regrid = "response",
  at = list(phase = c("OwnD3", "Baseline"))
)

e1_contrasts_d3 <- contrast(
  e1_conds_emmeans_d3,
  list(
    `Baseline Risk Averse - OwnD3 Risk Averse` = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),
    `OwnD3 Risk Seeking - Baseline Risk Seeking` = c(0, 1, 0, -1)
  )
)

e1_contrast_pairs_d3 <- as.data.frame(pairs(e1_contrasts_d3, infer = TRUE))
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$frame <- "Lives"
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$p_sig <- with(e1_contrast_pairs_d3, ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$p_lab <- with(
  e1_contrast_pairs_d3,
  cut(p.value, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
)
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$x <- 1
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$xend <- 2
e1_contrast_pairs_d3$y <- 0.45

fmt_conformity_table(e1_contrasts_subset_d3, e1_contrast_pairs_d3, "OwnD3")
```

Three days after norm exposure, participants in the moral domain continued to conform to both risk-averse and risk-seeking norms across Gains and Losses. Choice probabilities did not decay significantly between Day 0 and Day 3 in any cell (Gains Risk Averse: Δ*P* = 0.03, 95% CI [0.00, 0.07], *z* = 2.44, *p* = .055; Gains Risk Seeking: Δ*P* = 0.06, 95% CI [-0.02, 0.13], *z* = 2.01, *p* = .181; Losses Risk Averse: Δ*P* = -0.04, 95% CI [-0.09, 0.01], *z* = -2.08, *p* = .137; Losses Risk Seeking: Δ*P* = -0.03, 95% CI [-0.12, 0.05], *z* = -1.02, *p* = .738). As on Day 0, risk-averse norms remained significantly more influential than risk-seeking norms in Losses, while the two norms did not differ significantly in Gains. When predicting another group's decisions on Day 3, participants expected choices to remain shifted from baseline in the norm-consistent direction across all cells (*p*s < .001), matching their own Day 3 choices in the Risk Averse condition (Gains: Δ*P* = -0.01, *p* = .899; Losses: Δ*P* = 0.01, *p* = .963) and exceeding their own Day 3 gamble acceptance in the Risk Seeking condition (Gains: Δ*P* = 0.14, *p* < .001; Losses: Δ*P* = 0.19, *p* < .001).

    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")

# Difference plot by EV (OwnD3 - Baseline)
e1_baseline_data_d3 <- e1_predicted_probs_d3[e1_predicted_probs_d3$phase == "Baseline", ]
e1_own3_data_d3 <- e1_predicted_probs_d3[e1_predicted_probs_d3$phase == "OwnD3", ]

e1_diffs_d3 <- e1_own3_data_d3
e1_diffs_d3$predicted <- e1_own3_data_d3$Probability - e1_baseline_data_d3$Probability
e1_diffs_d3$conf.low <- e1_own3_data_d3$CI_low - e1_baseline_data_d3$CI_low
e1_diffs_d3$conf.high <- e1_own3_data_d3$CI_high - e1_baseline_data_d3$CI_high

e1_prob_diffs_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e1_diffs_d3, aes(x = ev, y = predicted, color = condition, fill = condition)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +

  labs(
    title = "Influence by Expected Value",
    x = "Gamble Expected Value (Lives)",
    y = "Difference in Probabilities of Gambling\n(OwnD3 - Baseline)",
    color = "Condition",
    fill = "Condition",
    linetype = "Condition"
  ) +

# Group probability plot across all four phases
e1_group_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e1_emmeans_df_d3, aes(x = phase, y = prob, fill = condition)) +

# Group difference plot (OwnD3 - Baseline)
e1_group_diffs_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e1_contrasts_subset_d3, aes(x = condition, y = estimate, fill = condition)) +

# Experiment 2: Monetary Domain (Money)

In Experiment 2, we estimate the corresponding baseline versus Day 3 choice curves, four-phase marginal means, three-day persistence shifts from baseline, and between-condition asymmetry contrasts.

```{r e2-d3-contrasts}
# Predicted probabilities for plotting (Baseline vs. OwnD3)
e2_predicted_probs_d3 <- estimate_means(
  e2_model_d3,
  by = c("phase = c('Baseline', 'OwnD3')", "condition", "domain", "ev"),
  length = 100
)

# Marginal means and contrasts across all four phases
e2_emmeans_d3 <- withr::with_seed(42, emmeans(
  e2_model_d3, revpairwise ~ phase | condition | domain,
  regrid = "response", infer = TRUE, adjust = "mvt",
  at = list(phase = c("Baseline", "OwnD0", "OwnD3", "Others"))
))
e2_emmeans_df_d3 <- as.data.frame(e2_emmeans_d3$emmeans)
e2_contrasts_df_d3 <- as.data.frame(e2_emmeans_d3$contrasts) %>%
  mutate(p_lab = cut(p.value, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
e2_contrasts_subset_d3 <- e2_contrasts_df_d3[grepl("OwnD3 - Baseline", e2_contrasts_df_d3$contrast), ]

# Contrasts of contrasts: (Baseline - OwnD3)[Risk Averse] vs. (OwnD3 - Baseline)[Risk Seeking]
e2_conds_emmeans_d3 <- emmeans(
  e2_model_d3, ~ condition * phase | domain,
  regrid = "response",
  at = list(phase = c("OwnD3", "Baseline"))
)

e2_contrasts_d3 <- contrast(
  e2_conds_emmeans_d3,
  list(
    `Baseline Risk Averse - OwnD3 Risk Averse` = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),
    `OwnD3 Risk Seeking - Baseline Risk Seeking` = c(0, 1, 0, -1)
  )
)

e2_contrast_pairs_d3 <- as.data.frame(pairs(e2_contrasts_d3, infer = TRUE))
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$frame <- "Money"
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$p_sig <- with(e2_contrast_pairs_d3, ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$p_lab <- with(
  e2_contrast_pairs_d3,
  cut(p.value, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
)
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$x <- 1
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$xend <- 2
e2_contrast_pairs_d3$y <- 0.45

all_contrast_pairs_d3 <- rbind(e1_contrast_pairs_d3, e2_contrast_pairs_d3)

fmt_conformity_table(e2_contrasts_subset_d3, e2_contrast_pairs_d3, "OwnD3")
```

In the monetary domain, the framing-dependent conformity pattern observed on Day 0 persisted at the three-day follow-up: in Gains, both risk-seeking and risk-averse norms differed significantly from baseline, with risk-seeking norms continuing to exert a much larger shift than risk-averse norms, whereas in Losses, risk-averse norms continued to reduce gambling strongly relative to baseline while risk-seeking norms showed no shift. Between Day 0 and Day 3, gamble acceptance was unchanged in Gains Risk Averse (Δ*P* = -0.03, 95% CI [-0.08, 0.01], *z* = -1.92, *p* = .215), Gains Risk Seeking (Δ*P* = 0.00, 95% CI [-0.07, 0.08], *z* = 0.16, *p* = .999), and Losses Risk Seeking (Δ*P* = -0.02, 95% CI [-0.09, 0.05], *z* = -0.79, *p* = .861), with partial rebound toward baseline in Losses Risk Averse (Δ*P* = 0.08, 95% CI [0.01, 0.14], *z* = 3.03, *p* = .013). Predictions for another group on Day 3 differed from baseline in the norm-consistent direction across all four cells (*p*s ≤ .001).

e2_prob_diffs_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e2_diffs_d3, aes(x = ev, y = predicted, color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = condition), linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted")) +
  scale_color_grey() +
  scale_fill_grey() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Influence by Expected Value",
    x = "Gamble Expected Value (Money)",
    y = "Difference in Probabilities of Gambling\n(OwnD3 - Baseline)",
    color = "Condition",
    fill = "Condition",
    linetype = "Condition"
  ) +
  facet_grid(contrast ~ domain) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "lines"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )

# Group probability plot across all four phases
e2_group_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e2_emmeans_df_d3, aes(x = phase, y = prob, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, position = position_dodge(width = 0.62), color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
    width = 0.09, position = position_dodge(width = 0.62)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Risk Averse" = "#5C5C5C", "Risk Seeking" = "#D6D6D6")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Gamble Acceptance by Phase",
    x = "Phase",
    y = "Probability of Choosing the Gamble Option",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.94, label = "Day 0", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = 0.94, label = "Day 3", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~domain) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11.5, margin = margin(b = 6, t = 4))
  )

# Group difference plot (OwnD3 - Baseline)
e2_group_diffs_plot_d3 <- ggplot(e2_contrasts_subset_d3, aes(x = condition, y = estimate, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_col(width = 0.28, position = position_dodge(width = 0.28), color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
    width = 0.07, position = position_dodge(width = 0.28)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = p_lab, y = ifelse(estimate > 0, (asymp.UCL + 0.055), (asymp.LCL - 0.075))),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.28), size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Risk Averse" = "#5C5C5C", "Risk Seeking" = "#D6D6D6")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, 0.25)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.52, 0.55)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  geom_signif(
    stat = "identity", data = all_contrast_pairs_d3[all_contrast_pairs_d3$frame == "Money", ],
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y, annotation = p_lab),
    comparisons = list("Risk Averse", "Risk Seeking"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Influence by Condition",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate more risky choices compared to baseline\nNegative values indicate more risk averse choices compared to baseline",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Difference in Probabilities of Gambling\n(OwnD3 - Baseline)",
    fill = "Difference"
  ) +
  facet_grid(~domain) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.justification = 0.5,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10.5, color = "grey25", margin = margin(b = 6)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11.5, margin = margin(b = 6, t = 4))
  )

fig5 <- e2_prob_plot_d3 + e2_prob_diffs_plot_d3 + e2_group_plot_d3 + e2_group_diffs_plot_d3 +
  plot_layout(design = layout) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "c", "b", "d")))

ggsave(here("output/fig5.pdf"), fig5, scale = 1.5, width = 10, height = 7)
fig5

#| include: false
key_results_day3 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(e1_contrasts_subset_d3, frame = "Lives", stage = "Follow-Up (Day 3)"),
  mutate(e2_contrasts_subset_d3, frame = "Money", stage = "Follow-Up (Day 3)")
) %>%
  left_join(
    select(all_contrast_pairs_d3, frame, domain, pair_p_lab = p_lab, pair_y = y),
    by = c("frame", "domain")
  ) %>%
  select(
    stage, frame, domain, condition, contrast,
    estimate, SE, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, z.ratio, p.value, p_lab,
    pair_p_lab, pair_y
  )

write_csv(key_results_day3, here("output/key_results_day3.csv"))
